name: Preliminary synthetic evaluation set
note: PRELIMINARY: 24 questions over a 4-document SYNTHETIC corpus. relevant_chunk_ids are resolved at run time by locating chunks that contain evidence_phrase inside relevant_document_id, so they stay correct if chunk size/overlap change.

questions.question: hardware security module
questions.expected_answer: Encryption keys are stored in a hardware security module.

questions.question: Recovery Time Objective
questions.expected_answer: Critical banking services must have an RTO of 4 hours.

questions.question: destruction certificate
questions.expected_answer: A destruction certificate must be filed when records are securely deleted at the end of retention.

questions.question: "tip off the customer"
questions.expected_answer: Employees must not tip off the customer that a report has been made.

questions.question: What does POL-SEC-007 require?
questions.expected_answer: Passwords of at least 12 characters, changed every 90 days, with MFA for privileged and remote access.

questions.question: DG-415
questions.expected_answer: Confirmed personal data breaches are reported to the regulator within 72 hours of confirmation.

questions.question: AML-11 threshold
questions.expected_answer: Cash deposits or withdrawals above 1000000 rupees in a month must be reported.

questions.question: VR-25
questions.expected_answer: Exit plans for material outsourcing contracts are tested once every 3 years.

questions.question: Why should organisations limit who can see customer identity documents and secrets?
questions.evidence_phrase: may be accessed only by named individuals
questions.expected_answer: Restricted data such as identity documents and authentication secrets may be accessed only by named individuals.

questions.question: How do we ensure a vendor can be replaced without losing our data?
questions.evidence_phrase: how services and data will be transferred back or to a new provider
questions.expected_answer: Material outsourcing contracts need an exit plan describing how services and data are transferred.

questions.question: Explain the approach to protecting data when employees work from home
questions.evidence_phrase: must connect through the approved corporate VPN
questions.expected_answer: Remote staff must use the approved VPN, may not store customer records on personal devices, and screens lock after 5 minutes.

questions.question: Why is it important to report money laundering suspicion without alerting the customer?
questions.evidence_phrase: Employees must not tip off the customer
questions.expected_answer: Employees must not tip off the customer that a suspicious transaction report has been made.

questions.question: How often do I need to swap my login secret?
questions.expected_answer: Passwords must be changed every 90 days.

questions.question: What happens to the computer screen when someone steps away for a few minutes while working off-site?
questions.evidence_phrase: lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity
questions.expected_answer: Screens lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity.

questions.question: How quickly must a serious cyber event be flagged to the security team?
questions.expected_answer: Suspected incidents must be reported to the Security Operations Centre within 1 hour of discovery.

questions.question: For how long do we keep old client paperwork collected at account opening?
questions.evidence_phrase: Customer onboarding documents are retained for 5 years
questions.expected_answer: Customer onboarding documents are retained for 5 years.

questions.question: Under POL-SEC-019, how should encryption keys be managed and why?
questions.expected_answer: Keys are stored in a hardware security module and rotated every 12 months.

questions.question: How does the RTO requirement in BCP-05 relate to how often we test failover?
questions.evidence_phrase: tested twice a year through a full failover drill
questions.expected_answer: Continuity plans are tested twice a year through a full failover drill.

questions.question: Explain how AML-15 sanctions screening should work when a possible match is found
questions.evidence_phrase: the transaction is held until the match is cleared
questions.expected_answer: Potential matches are escalated to the compliance officer and the transaction is held until the match is cleared.

questions.question: What should MFA protect according to POL-SEC-007 and why is it needed for remote access?
questions.evidence_phrase: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all privileged accounts
questions.expected_answer: MFA is mandatory for privileged accounts and any remote access to the corporate network.

questions.question: What is the organisation's policy on employee parental leave?
What is the maximum interest rate charged on personal loans?
Who is the current chief executive of the organisation?
What is on the cafeteria menu this Friday?
